facts.fact: 全章为房东 Roger 的 POV：他被两个女人打倒在自家公寓地板上，仰面流血、几乎动不了，背伤来自当年摔下楼梯。
facts.anchor: his fucking back, never been the same since he fell down those stairs

facts.fact: Roger 偷偷在 Lucy 公寓里装了新摄像头，用来监视她有没有“干坏事”。
facts.anchor: Snuck a new camera into Lucy’s apartment so he could make sure

facts.fact: Roger 自信 Lucy 就算拆掉第一个摄像头，也找不到第二个和第三个，他擅长藏摄像头。
facts.anchor: but she’ll never find the second one. Or the third.

facts.fact: Roger 认出 Lucy 手里的东西是前房客 Nate 的大理石半身像，Nate 说那是他祖母的遗物。
facts.anchor: That was Nate’s marble bust. Said it belonged to his grandmother.

facts.fact: Roger 觉得那半身像又重又没用，早前直接送去 Goodwill 处理掉了。
facts.anchor: Roger took it to Goodwill just to get rid of it.

facts.fact: Roger 记得是 Saskia 用球棒打了他，并认为她别想逃掉。
facts.anchor: She hit him with a fucking bat!

facts.fact: 他嘴被打坏，只能含混地命令 Lucy“叫救护车”，还指望她会听话帮他。
章末落点：Lucy 站在他上方，先冲他笑了一下，然后把大理石半身像砸在他脸上。
facts.anchor: And she drops the marble bust on his face.
